patch_description: This makes a controlled increase to the current program’s two-hop path strength, from 0.46 to 0.56, while leaving its demand transform, relay-pressure discount, edge discount, and penalty weight unchanged. The intent is to give useful indirect routes somewhat more influence without changing the established term structure; this is one of the recommended sweep values to compare against the current setting. The function still uses only demand data and emits at most \(n(n-1)(n-2)\) quadratic terms.
